name: tomc-memory
description: Prepare task-specific context from supplied history for your existing assistant.
long_description: Give TOMC a history, the next task and a memory budget. It prepares context on CPU using selected source text and supported task records; your existing assistant writes the answer. No extra model API key or model service is required. Optional notebooks keep supplied history across chats. An API application can send prepared context instead of the full history in its next request; a tool call does not remove existing host history or intercept every request. Counts and the budget cover memory text under a lexical estimate, excluding task text, tool envelopes and provider framing. Short histories can stay intact, and savings depend on the context sent. The first installation needs network access to download the runtime and dependencies.

tools.name: prepare_context
tools.description: Prepare supplied history for the next task without saving it; budget covers estimated memory tokens.

tools.name: remember_memory
tools.description: Optionally save user-supplied history in a named notebook.

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.description: Prepare an optional notebook's history for the next task.

tools.name: forget_memory
tools.description: Delete a specified notebook when requested.
